user.title: Sign in to Bilka To Go
user.description: Use the household's Bilka To Go account. Prices and offers follow the store the account picks up from.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Bilka To Go again
reauth_confirm.description: Bilka refused the stored password for {email}. Enter the current one.

error.invalid_auth: Bilka refused the email or password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Bilka To Go. Try again in a moment.
error.no_pickup_store: The account has no pickup store yet. Choose one on bilkatogo.dk first.

abort.already_configured: This Bilka account is already set up.

get_transfer.name: Get transfer
get_transfer.description: The basket summary, and every item on the shopping list with its previously chosen products in preference order.

search.name: Search Bilka
search.description: Search the pickup store's range, in Bilka's own order.

offers_only.name: Offers only
offers_only.description: Only products on offer in the store.

move.name: Move item
move.description: Put a product in the Bilka basket for an item, and take the item off the shopping list.

item.name: Item
item.description: The item's id on the shopping list.

count.name: Count
count.description: How many to add on top of what the basket holds.

forget.name: Forget product

empty_basket.name: Empty basket
empty_basket.description: Remove every product from the Bilka basket. The packing choice stays.

item_not_on_list.message: That item is no longer on the shopping list.
